changelog:
rd-ip-accelerator v1.0.0

- Initial release of the all-in-one R&D IP accelerator, delivering six key IP modules for innovative enterprises across industries.
- Fully integrated modules: Litigation Intelligence, Competitor Intelligence Monitoring (with full tech-intel-monitor logic), FTO Analysis, Solution Exploration, Novelty Search, and Technical Disclosure generation.
- Single-skill installation: all core features provided natively, no need for additional skill installations.
- Dual-mode execution for all modules: prioritizes dedicated sub-skill if installed, falls back to internal logic otherwise.
- Automated HTML/PDF/Word report generation for all modules with visual standards, workflow chaining, and smart recommendations between modules.
- Designed for end-to-end patent workflow, from IP awareness to high-quality patent application, with seamless enterprise-oriented triggers and functional linkage.
